M-CODEX-HOOK.Purpose: Implement the Codex adapter dispatch: read classification transport, notices, and lifecycle resets.

Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Graph, knowledge schema, Resolution, root detection, cache, ontology implementation.

Requirements.REQ-001: `post_tool_use` maps shared-classifier read paths (`read_classifier::classify_reads`) to the bundled Core ancestor-context transport; relative reads resolve against the hook input `cwd` (`resolve_read`).
Requirements.REQ-002: `post_tool_use` resolves the diagnostics mode and emits delivery and diagnostics messages through `systemMessage`.
Requirements.REQ-003: `session_start` resolves the diagnostics mode and resets session state; `context_id` == `session_id + agent_id`; `post_compact` resets context.
Requirements.REQ-004: The hook receives `FLI_DIAGNOSTICS` from the Codex process environment.

Inputs.IN-001: `HookInput` JSON on stdin: event name, session identity, tool input.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Updates bundled Core delivery state for the session context.
